description: Prepare for and run a negotiation with structure: BATNA and ZOPA analysis, counterparty analysis, a 6-dimension score for any draft message, a pre-send checklist, and a concession ledger across rounds. Use for salary offers, vendor and supplier contracts, billing disputes, partnership terms, and any deal where the next message matters. Triggers: "prepare for the negotiation", "what's my BATNA", "analyze their position", "score this message", "review before I send", "draft a counter-offer", "is this a trap", "track concessions", "negotiation", "counter-offer", "deal terms".
